The operation caused heavy casualties, damaged the sacred Akal Takht, and caused profound trauma to the Sikh community worldwide. On 31 October 1984, Indira Gandhi was assassinated by two of her Sikh bodyguards, triggering horrific, organized anti-Sikh violence across Delhi and other cities, resulting in over 2,700 deaths.
